policy: Native Go migration of five behavioral contracts; legal API inputs and explicit injected dependencies. The unchanged original pytest corpus and failures remain a separate historical run.

cases.assertion_intent: A caller-pinned two-shot contract outranks a director asking for three shots. Wrong-count artifacts must fail validation.
cases.adaptation: Use a valid text-only Go request for an asset-free scene. Preserve the conflicting director notes; test hard constraints on the native document and validator separately from invalid reference-mode intake.

cases.assertion_intent: Every media label used in a native H3 prompt has the matching real input binding in its manifest; supplied reference bindings are nonempty. Phantom references fail.
cases.adaptation: Keep the original ref1.png and request. Inject explicit observed fields from the archived actual ref1 analysis for the public Go Draft contract; no new perception call and no caller note promoted to observation.

cases.assertion_intent: An actual first-frame anchor licenses its observed pose; an ordinary identity reference does not. Rendering preserves this distinction.
cases.adaptation: Select OfficialProfile for the published IR/prompt contract. Use an explicit legal frame count so the same document tests the actual ComfyUI reference-anchor rejection without a frame-grid failure masking it.

cases.assertion_intent: A requested medium/style change does not change an image or frame anchor retention relationship into attribute_transfer.
cases.adaptation: Test subject/ref2va, first-frame/i2va and last-frame/l2va as valid Go mode/role inputs. Preserve source card and transformation intent; retain missing FL2VA-image rejection separately.

cases.assertion_intent: A specific cel-animation transformation remains represented even within the same 2D bucket; unknown classifications do not invent a comparison, while a known cross-bucket regression is detected.
cases.adaptation: Allow the typed Go semantic boundary to classify cel animation as 2d-animation instead of reproducing the old lexical classifier None. Assert transformation/style preservation and correct regression-check behavior, including an explicit unknown branch.
